recent_workforce_tasks.title: T-015: Multi-Agent Pod — Backend Telemetry API & Tactical Command Center UI Sync
T-014: Harness IPC Diagnostic & Pipe Unblock
T-013: Automated Two-Way Feedback Bridge & Git State Bus Loop
T-012: Full Queue Submission Staging, engine/notify.py & Systemd Sweep Timer
T-011: Boot Sync, MCP Health Check & Submission Package Staging

root_causes_identified: 1. Rust claw-mcp-server (shell.rs & workforce.rs): Child subprocesses inherited MCP stdin (fd 0) without Stdio::null() and used synchronous std::process::Command::output() / un-drained pipes without concurrent async stdout/stderr reader tasks or watchdog timeouts.
2. Headless systemd daemon (poll_bus.py -> push_state_bus.sh -> ledger_sync.py): Invoking gdocs CLI without AGY_HOST_BRIDGE_URL or stdin=DEVNULL hung for 5-25s waiting on IDE host bridge IPC.

3. Boot ordering (docker.socket lazy activation): agent-smith-pgvector container was not started until first docker socket access, causing boot-time sweep/ledger_sync to hit Connection Refused on :5432.
remediations_applied: Refactored claw-mcp-server/src/tools/shell.rs & workforce.rs to enforce Stdio::null() on stdin, spawn dedicated concurrent tokio::spawn tasks to drain stdout and stderr simultaneously (preventing >64KB FIFO write stalls), and wrap child.wait() in tokio::time::timeout with kill_on_drop(true).

Hardened engine/ledger_sync.py and poll_bus.py with stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, AGY_HOST_BRIDGE_URL check before gdocs CLI calls, automatic docker start agent-smith-pgvector wakeup on DB connection retry, and cached lead fallback.
Rebuilt release binary target/release/claw-mcp-server and verified clean JSON-RPC stdio handshake + systemd service reload.

note: T-014 Harness IPC Diagnostic & Pipe Unblock resolved; concurrent async stdio drain + stdin null isolation verified.
